reason: The README describes a DSH Web settings extension whose primary user-facing function is navigating and editing settings and composition configuration through a browser interface.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供基于 Web 的设置导航与配置编辑界面，支持按 schema 展示字段并管理组合配置。
summaries.en: Provides DSH with a Web-based settings navigator and configuration editor that renders schema-backed fields and manages composition settings.

capabilities: Provides a loopback Web settings interface
Enumerates registered settings namespaces and schema-bearing composition rows
Renders schema-based settings editors and navigation sections
Applies, persists, resets, and removes configuration edits
Serves a browser bundle and crawler-owned web route
